tha-ap154:1.1: Tambapupphiya.] Parakammāyane yutto aparādhaṃ akās' ahaṃ / vanantaṃ atidhāvissaṃ bhayabheravasamappito. // //
tha-ap154:2.1: Pupphitaṃ pādapaṃ disvā piṇḍibaddhaṃ sunimmitaṃ / tambapupphaṃ gahetvāna bodhiyaṃ okiriṃ ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap154:3.1: Sammajjitvāna taṃ bodhiṃ pāṭalipādamuttamaṃ / pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvāna bodhimūle upāvisiṃ. // //
tha-ap154:4.1: Gatamaggaṃ gavesanto āgañchuṃ mama santike / te ca dīsvān' ahaṃ tattha āvajjiṃ bodhim uttamaṃ. // //
tha-ap154:5.1: Vanditvā ca ahaṃ bodhiṃ vippasannena cetasā / anekatālīsa patiṃ giridugge bhayānake. // //
tha-ap154:6.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yam puppham abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi bodhipūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap154:7.1: Ito ca tatiye kappe rājā Samphusito ahu / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahābalo. // //
tha-ap154:9.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Tambapupphiya thero i. g. a-ti.
